piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: Numbers, age and basic details
texto: Basic numbers and expressing age in Thai: the basic digits are «หนึ่ง» (nʉ̀ng, one), «สอง» (sɔ̌ɔng, two), «สาม» (sǎam, three), «สี่» (sìi, four), «ห้า» (hâa, five). The word «อายุ» (ʔaayúʔ) means «age». The pattern for saying your age is direct: [Subject] + «อายุ» + [Number] + «ปี» (bpii, year classifier). Example: «ฉันอายุยี่สิบปี» (I am 20 years old). Notice that Thai does not use the verb «to have» («มี») for age; instead, the idea of age goes directly with the number and the year classifier.
